We can make use of Taylor’s theorem to write the identity
\[P_h=P_0+h\left.\frac{dP_t}{dt}\right|_{t=0}+\cdots+\frac{h^n}{n!}\left.\frac{d^nP_t}{dt^n}\right|_{t=0}
+\frac{h^{n+1}}{n!}\int_0^1(1-\lambda)^n\left.\frac{d^{n+1}P_t}{dt^{n+1}}\right|_{t=\lambda h}d\lambda,\]
for some finite truncation index $n\in\{1,2,3,\ldots\}$. The remainder term at order $h^{n+1}$ will involve the integration of finitely many derivatives of its argument. Hence for observables of sufficient smoothness with compact support, this remainder term will remain bounded (see [223]).
